description: This file defines a custom permission class 'IsOwner' for a Django REST Framework project, which restricts access to objects based on ownership. It imports permission base classes and a Note model, implementing logic to allow access only to objects owned by the requesting user.

classes.name: IsOwner
classes.description: A custom permission class that grants access only if the request user owns the object, specifically used for Note objects in a Django REST Framework context.

methods.name: has_object_permission(self, request, view, obj)
methods.description: Checks if the requesting user owns the object (Note), granting permission only if the owner_id matches the user's id.
